subject: Mental Models
title: OODA Loop
description: A quick, practical guide to OODA Loop.

hook.text: Colonel John Boyd's fighter pilots won dogfights not by flying faster but by deciding faster.

buildup.text: The OODA loop is Observe, Orient, Decide, Act.

discovery.text: Boyd developed this in the 1960s. He proved that confusion is a weapon.

twist.text: The Orient step is key. Observation is useless without interpretation.

climax.text: Shorten your loop. Gather information quickly, interpret it honestly, decide confidently, and act.

punchline.text: Decide faster than opponents. Speed wins fights.
